name: Wind Knight
description: A noble knight mounted on armored wings. Wing Knight soars above the stadium, using its winged armor to deflect attacks and retaliate with precise slashing strikes from above.

ability.name: Wing Guard
ability.description: When Wing Knight successfully defends, its wings absorb the impact — reducing damage taken by 25 and dealing 20 recoil damage to the attacker. Every 3 successful defenses, Wing Knight launches a Wing Dive: +35 ATK for 2 turns and ignores enemy defense on the next attack.

chain._note: Wing Guard: 20 recoil damage on defense win

special_move.name: Wing Dive Slash
special_move.description: Wing Knight folds its wings and dives from above — a three-hit aerial assault that strikes before the opponent can react!
flavour_texts: 🦅 **Wing Dive Slash** — the knight takes flight!
